context: A senpai walks with a teen friend
purpose: Teach: 見本/北側/理不尽/歩ん/裏切ら/尽くす/宅配/治る

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、研究室の見本資料、北側に新しく並んでるよ。
lines.en: Sakura, there are new sample materials lined up on the north side.
lines.style: Light, straightforward share. Gentle at the opening — not demanding attention, just noticing she might find this useful. Warm curiosity underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。先輩、理不尽な発表会の制度、相談していいですか。
lines.en: Yes, senpai. Could I talk to you about the presentation system? It feels unfair to me.
lines.style: Respectful but genuine. Tests the question carefully — she wants his real thoughts, not a speech. Slight hesitation before 'unfair,' like she's checking if it's okay to say it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: うん。共に歩んできた後輩のため、力になる。
lines.en: Yeah, of course. I'll help however I can.
lines.style: Warm and steady. No performance of mentorship — just a quiet offer. Lean into the certainty without making it heavy.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 同期に裏切られた友達もいて、辛そうです。
lines.en: One of my friends got betrayed by someone in our year. She's been really hurting about it.
lines.style: Careful, observant. She's not just reporting facts — she's noticed the pain and it matters to her. Soft on 'betrayed,' protective on 'hurting.'

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 信頼に尽くす姿勢、最後は伝わる。
lines.en: Being loyal and genuine — those things actually do show in the end.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Not lecturing, offering something he's had to learn himself. Quiet conviction. Eye contact steady.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 今度、皆で宅配で集まろうって、誘いました。
lines.en: So I invited everyone to come over and get food delivered. Just be together.
lines.style: Lighter, almost relieved. She's found something she can do. Small smile in the voice — practical kindness, nothing dramatic.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: いいね。心の傷、治るきっかけになる。
lines.en: That's really good. Sometimes just gathering like that — that's when healing can start.
lines.style: Warm close. Genuine approval. Slow finish, like he's watching that kindness land. Soft but not tentative.
